title: Story Repair Shop
shareTitle: Story Repair Shop — Mend a Missing Ending
description: Listen to a tiny story, open the paper repair tray, and fit the painted ending that makes sense—or makes the story wonderfully wild.
learningGoals: Predict logical results from story causes and clues
Distinguish plausible events from intentionally impossible ones
Build listening comprehension and oral narrative language
Practice spatial matching through drag-and-drop with equal tap access
interactionModel: Custom paper-repair loop with a narrated torn story, authored three-card tray, drag-to-slot placement, and equivalent tap-card/tap-slot controls.
feedbackModel: Wrong pieces wobble and return without penalty while the story replays; correct pieces reveal the finished watercolor scene with sparkle, narration, and a page turn.
